description: Unsigned transactions to lend a stock to shorters (it earns lending fees) or USDG in the Borro USDG vault (it earns interest). With post: true, a stock is lent and posted in one step so USDG can be borrowed against it.

amount.description: Amount to lend, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

post.description: Stock only: lend and post as collateral in one step

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign
